summary: Iter 5 (Pillar rename + rate limits + batch admin + leaderboard + recommender flags) tested. Backend pytest: 39/39 PASSED. Frontend smoke: nav '★ The Pillars' with testid nav-pillars, /pillars and /champions both render pillar-hero, Admin shows 4 tabs (pending/keys/logs/board), batch-toolbar with select-all toggling enabled state on approve/reject buttons, leaderboard-list renders. Korean rate-limit message confirmed visible to user during login flow ('요청이 너무 많습니다. 잠시 후 다시 시도해주세요.').

minor.issue: slowapi moving-window is mildly flaky on sequential calls — sometimes 5 sequential forgot-password / 13 sequential login calls go through before the 429 fires. Limit eventually triggers; tests had to be widened to 8/25 calls. Acceptable with default in-memory storage; consider switching to fixed-window or Redis-backed storage for stricter cap.

logger.info("OTP resend for ... (dev): {code}") on line 411 and "Password reset for ... (dev token): {token}" on line 454 are NOT gated behind DEV_MODE. Only _issue_otp (line 296-297) is gated. APP_ENV=prod will still log resend-OTPs and password-reset tokens in plaintext.

All tests share the proxy IP behind k8s ingress, so /auth/login's 10/min globally throttles ALL admins/users from any browser at once. Consider keying on (ip, email) for login OR allowing admin@iastate.edu a higher quota. Currently any test/login burst will lock out real users for 60s.

ui_bugs.issue: pillar-badge data-testid not present on post-detail page when navigating from /pillars list (pillar item exists but no badge rendered on detail). May be conditional on is_pillar=true vs is_champion mirror or the post was a boosted-but-not-yet-pillar entry from /pillars (which also returns boost_likes>0 posts).

issues: Visible nav reads '★ The Pillars' (Title Case) but problem statement specified '★ THE PILLARS' all-caps. Cosmetic — fix via CSS uppercase.

action_items: Gate logger.info('OTP resend for ...') (server.py:411) and logger.info('Password reset for ...') (server.py:454) behind DEV_MODE to fully implement APP_ENV=prod log suppression

Verify pillar-badge renders on /posts/{pillar_post_id} detail page; if currently scoped to is_pillar only, ensure mirrored is_champion (or boosted) posts also surface the badge or filter list accordingly
Apply CSS uppercase to nav-pillars text to match spec ('★ THE PILLARS')
(Optional) Switch slowapi storage to fixed-window or Redis for tighter accuracy & shared state across workers/instances
(Optional) Per (ip,email) login limiter to avoid throttling real users when one IP misbehaves
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1210 lines (was 1090). Strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, admin, pillars, posts, messages) — 73% over the 700-line guideline.
Two log lines (lines 411, 454) bypass DEV_MODE gating — leaks OTP/reset-tokens in prod logs.
Rate-limit decorators are correctly placed (slowapi @limiter.limit BELOW @api.post) and request: Request is first positional param — correct.
/admin/batch-approve and /batch-reject sequentially await send_admin_decision per uid; for 50+ users this serially waits on Resend. Wrap in asyncio.gather.
_migrate_pillar_rename runs on every startup — fine since $rename is idempotent, but the initial scan is unbounded; add a one-time flag in a meta collection.

success_rate.frontend: Smoke 90% — Pillar nav/route/alias, 4 admin tabs, batch toolbar enable/disable, leaderboard, Pillar copy verified. Pillar-badge on post-detail not seen.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (39 tests). Key helpers: _admin_session() retries on 429 with sleep(62); _register_invite() retries on 429; TestZRateLimits class is intentionally last to avoid poisoning per-IP login bucket.
